[!hasJSONV2] skip 'encoding/json/v2 requires a go1.26 or later toolchain in PATH'

env GOEXPERIMENT=jsonv2

muxt generate --output-jsonv2 --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /filter datastar(Update(ctx, signals))" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.25
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Filter struct {
	Query string `json:"query"`
}

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Update(_ context.Context, f Filter) (string, error) { return f.Query, nil }
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	t.Run("valid signals decode", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/filter", strings.NewReader(`{"query":"go"}`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if want := "<p>go</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})

	// encoding/json/v2 rejects duplicate member names where v1 takes the
	// last value; the wire-visible difference proves which library decoded
	// the signals (the v1 archive pins the acceptance).
	t.Run("duplicate keys are rejected under jsonv2", func(t *testing.T) {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/filter", strings.NewReader(`{"query":"a","query":"b"}`))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
	})
}
